summary.en: Prefer clear has-a relationships and delegate changing policies to collaborators.
summary.bn: has-a সম্পর্ক স্পষ্ট করুন এবং পরিবর্তনশীল কাজ সহযোগী অবজেক্টকে দিন।

notes: Java 17 requires no special feature for delegation; ownership is a design promise, not a keyword.

sections.title: A ticket uses a policy rather than becoming one
Store a collaborator and forward the request
Follow references instead of climbing a class hierarchy
Choose by the promise, not by shared lines
Distinguish Java composition from the stronger UML relation
Share deliberately and validate at useful entry points
Watch the references that cross the boundary

examples.title: Delegate a fare calculation
examples.explanationHtml: Ticket has a Rate. It forwards the calculation rather than inheriting a particular rate implementation.

examples.title: A private owned component
examples.explanationHtml: Each Lamp creates and keeps its own SwitchState. The component is not exposed to outside aliases.

examples.title: Replace a collaborator without changing the client type
examples.explanationHtml: Display stays the same object while its formatting policy changes. The wrapper controls how callers reach the collaborator.

practice.title: Composed delivery fee
practice.statementHtml: Read weight (0..100) and rate (0..100). RateCalculator stores rate and computes weight times rate. Parcel has a calculator supplied through its constructor and delegates cost(weight). Print the cost.
hints: Parcel has a calculator; it is not a calculator.

practice.title: Independent counters
practice.statementHtml: Read a and b (0..20). Each Desk owns a private Counter created inside Desk. Visit the first desk a times and the second b times. Print their counts separated by one space.
hints: Avoid static component state when each desk needs its own count.

practice.title: Replace an invalid subtype
practice.statementHtml: A Stack extends a general list and exposes insert-at-index. Why does this harm a strict stack abstraction? Propose a composition design.
practice.answerHtml: A strict stack permits access at one end. Inheriting arbitrary insertion exposes operations outside that contract. Stack can instead keep a private list and expose push, pop and isEmpty only. Delegation reuses storage while controlling the public boundary.
hints: List reuse does not require Stack to be a list.

practice.title: Choose ownership
practice.statementHtml: Two Departments share one Printer object supplied by the caller. Is this strong UML composition? Explain the lifetime policy.
practice.answerHtml: The departments refer to a shared independent printer. This is an association, possibly shared aggregation if that meaning helps the model. Strong composition would assert exclusive whole-part ownership. Deleting a Department reference should not imply destroying a printer still used elsewhere.
hints: A private reference alone does not establish exclusive ownership.

quiz.prompt: What fare does the composed policy choose?
quiz.explanation: Ticket delegates to RegularRate, which multiplies distance by four.

quiz.prompt: Do two owners share components created inside their constructors?
quiz.explanation: Each Owner creates a different Part, so only a changes.

quiz.prompt: What does an intentionally shared collaborator reveal?
quiz.explanation: Both wrappers hold aliases to the same Part, so b observes the increment.
A policy collaborator is owned or referenced by Ticket rather than being its superclass.
options: A ticket has a fare policy
A square satisfies a shape contract
A scholar satisfies a student contract

quiz.explanation: The owner controls the public request and asks another object to perform a task.

quiz.prompt: Why often favour composition for changing policy?
quiz.explanation: Separating collaborators avoids multiplying subclasses for unrelated variation axes.
options: Policies can vary independently of the owner hierarchy

quiz.prompt: Does a private final field guarantee exclusive ownership?
quiz.explanation: A final field fixes its reference, while ownership depends on how the object is created and shared.
options: No, outside aliases may still exist

quiz.prompt: When is inheritance still a good fit?
quiz.explanation: Behavioural substitutability matters more than text reuse.
options: Whenever two classes share a few lines
When every subtype preserves the parent contract

quiz.explanation: Delegation has design and implementation costs, so choose useful boundaries rather than wrapping everything.

quiz.prompt: Which UML relation indicates exclusive whole-part ownership?
quiz.explanation: The diamond belongs to the whole, and the model promises exclusive ownership.
options: Composition with a filled diamond at the whole
Inheritance with a triangle at the child

keyPoints.en: Use is-a for substitutable types and has-a for collaborators.
keyPoints.bn: বিকল্প হিসেবে ব্যবহারযোগ্য টাইপে is-a, সহযোগী অবজেক্টে has-a ব্যবহার করুন।

keyPoints.en: Delegation forwards work through a controlled public boundary.
keyPoints.bn: ডেলিগেশন নিয়ন্ত্রিত ইন্টারফেস দিয়ে কাজ অন্য অবজেক্টকে দেয়।

keyPoints.en: Composition lets policies vary without multiplying owner subclasses.
keyPoints.bn: কম্পোজিশনে মালিক ক্লাসের অসংখ্য সাবক্লাস ছাড়াই নীতি বদলানো যায়।

keyPoints.en: Ownership must be designed rather than inferred from final.
keyPoints.bn: final দেখে মালিকানা ধরে নেবেন না, মালিকানার নিয়ম ঠিক করুন।

keyPoints.en: Inheritance remains useful when the full parent contract holds.
keyPoints.bn: প্যারেন্টের পুরো চুক্তি বজায় থাকলে ইনহেরিট্যান্স উপযোগী।

examQuestions.question: Draw a Ticket that delegates to a Rate interface.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
Ticket --> Rate
            ^
            | implements
       ReducedRate

Ticket keeps a Rate reference and forwards fare requests. Rate implementations change independently from Ticket. The association does not by itself promise exclusive ownership.

examQuestions.question: Compare subclass explosion with two independent policy fields.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Combining three fare policies with four text styles could produce twelve dedicated subclasses. A FarePolicy and Style collaborator permit those combinations without twelve owner classes. This adds constructor choices and delegation, so validate collaborators and keep their contracts narrow.

examQuestions.question: Explain when a private component still leaks mutable state.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Storing a caller-owned mutable object preserves an alias. Returning the component also exposes an alias. Choose intentional sharing, defensive copying, or a narrow interface according to the required ownership rule.
